header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Endure Hardships and difficulties when Giving Da'wah towards Allaah

blocks.text: Qiyaamah) We shall inherit from him (We shall be the complete owners of) all that (wealth and children which) he speaks about and he will come to Us all alone (without anything in his possession).[^1]

Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) narrates that he once approached Rasulullaah ﷺ as he lay in the shade of the Kabah using a shawl as a pillow. It was a time when the Muslims were suffering terrible torture at the hands of the Mushrikeen. Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) asked Rasulullaah ﷺ, "Will you not pray to Allaah (to stop the hardships)?" Rasulullaah ﷺ sat up straight and his face was red as he said, "Before you there were people whose flesh and tissues were scraped to the bone with iron combs. However, even this did not make them turn away from their religion. Allaah shall definitely bring this Deen to a completion until a time comes when a lone rider will travel from Sa'aa to Hadramaut fearing nothing but Allaah and wolves attacking his goats. However, you people want to rush it."[^2]
Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) Endures Hardships and Difficulties
Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) Dispatches His Brother when he Hears about the Nabuwaat of Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that when Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) heard that Rasulullaah ﷺ was sent as a Rasul, he said to his brother, "Ride to that valley (of Makkah) and find out for me about the man who claims that he is a Rasul and that revelation comes to him from the heavens. Hear what he has to say and then report back to me." His brother arrived in Makkah, heard what Rasulullaah ﷺ said and then reported back to Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) saying, "I saw him teaching sterling character and reciting words that are not poetry." Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) said, "Your report has not informed me what I needed to know."
Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) Arrives in Makkah, Accepts Islaam and is then made to Suffer for the sake of Allaah

Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) took some provisions and a filled waterbag along with him and rode off to Makkah. When he entered the Masjidul Haraam, he searched for Rasulullaah ﷺ but did not recognise him. He did not want to ask anyone about Rasulullaah ﷺ either and when night fell, he lay down to sleep. Hadhrat Ali (RA) saw him and realised that he was a stranger.
